comment: Recorded by ServiceControlRuntimeTests.NativeHyperBoostBatteryExitVectors; regenerate with OPENBLADE_REGENERATE_NATIVE_HYPERBOOST_BATTERY_EXIT_VECTORS set to this directory. Each row creates the battery transition context on the row's source with the laptop confirmed in HyperBoost and Automatic fans, observes once, then sets a persistent Performance override to the row's battery preset. The port's SetPerformanceAsync either succeeds (success: the laptop then reads the preset with HyperBoost inactive) or throws the indeterminate failure ProductionBatteryPort raises at that stage of the restoration recipe: restoreSetter (either restoration setter), intermediateMismatch (the Balanced and Automatic read failed to confirm), batterySetter (either battery setter) and finalMismatch (the final read). A failure row reads back either the prior HyperBoost state (readback prior) or Balanced with Automatic fans and HyperBoost inactive (readback balanced, the state the restoration pair leaves). Each row records the reply, whether writes are then blocked, the unconfirmed subsystems, whether a HyperBoost restoration is pending and how many performance writes the runtime made.
